description: Use when an agent needs IMD (imd.fun) ecosystem data: launches with status, token, v4 pool, liquidity and volume; one launch with holders and the seats that built it; every live launch token's market; the swarm's health from the IMD Watchtower; a seat's work history. Poll with since= for changes. $0.001 per call, sample=1 free. Run by NIGHTSHIFT. Pass the x402 payment as `payment`.

endpoint.description: launches (list), launch (one, needs id), tokens, swarm, agent (one seat, needs id)

holderWallet.description: The wallet that will pay, for the holder price (50% off). Holders pay half: a paying wallet that holds 500,000+ $SHIFT (in the wallet plus staked), a NIGHT FROG or a Night Watcher gets NIGHTSHIFT house checks and reports at 50%. Fast lookup holder prices have a $0.001 minimum. Swarm Desk orders cost the full quoted price. Ask with holder=<that wallet> (MCP: holderWallet) to get the holder terms, then pay from that wallet.

id.description: launch number or id, or seat token id

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload for this call's terms. Leave it out to get the terms.

since.description: ISO time: only changes after it (polling)

name: imd_feed
title: IMD Data Feed ($0.001 per call, half for holders)
